title: full-example-deep-field-6-settings-20261023

design.question: On the abstract field preset, with every kind of agent and money following earnings, which of the six rule settings gets furthest?
design.compare: Traditional, OSO (immediate), OSO (choice), Flow-back, finished-only, No flow-back, immediate, No flow-back, choice
design.measure: all of hardest level, targets solved, bounty value, ROI, knowledge found (bits), knowledge per unit of money, money to the main level, waste

answer: Best overall: OSO. Against traditional, clearly better on hardest level, targets solved, bounty value, ROI, knowledge found (bits), knowledge per unit of money, money to the main level and waste. (8 measures; a clear difference is more than 2.7 standard errors.)
answers: hardest level: 8.00 against traditional 3.28, clearly better.
targets solved: 3.74 against traditional 0.56, clearly better.
bounty value: 1915 against traditional 287, clearly better.
knowledge found (bits): 159 against traditional 87, clearly better.
knowledge per unit of money: 0.23 against traditional 0.09, clearly better.
money to the main level: 399 against traditional 731, clearly better.
caveats: A simulation with guessed parameters: it shows how the rules play out, not that they work.
